product.olivetti-m6-640-dp.summary: The M6-640 variant with two Pentiums operating in parallel.
product.olivetti-m6-640-dp.history: Olivetti documented the M6-640 DP as the dual-processor variant of the M6-640.
product.olivetti-m6-640-dp.architecture: The board leaves video to a separate card. The BA2173 takes two 90 MHz Pentiums and has no onboard video controller.
product.olivetti-m6-640-dp.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m6-640-dp.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m6-640-dp.service-guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, vol. II, ch. 11
product.olivetti-m6-640-dp.firmware: The revision helps identify the service BIOS. The guide lists 1.16.
